title: Numbering (document numbers)
summary: Numbers for business documents — INV/BDG/2026/10/0007 — per company and, if chosen, per branch, restarting each year, month, or day, without gaps: a number is taken inside the posting's transaction and a rollback gives it back. Formats editable per company, previews, and raising the next number when moving from another system. Offers NumberingClient.
when_to_use: A module posts documents that need a sequential number (invoices, orders, receipts, payslips, stock moves).
when_not_to_use: Tax invoice numbers (NSFP / e-Faktur) — Coretax issues those; store them with the tax module.
Codes of master data (customer, item codes) — those are typed or generated by their own module.

ports.name: Units
ports.description: The codes of companies and branches, and the company's branches — what {COMPANY} and {BRANCH} print and the page previews. Without it they print IDs.

permissions.name: numbering.manage
permissions.description: Mengubah format dan nomor berikutnya dokumen
